verdict.rationale: Clara documents registrable webhook subscriptions: you provide a callback URL, the transaction statuses to watch, and a signing secret, and Clara POSTs HMAC-SHA256-signed events to your endpoint. The sandbox also supports subscriptions and on-demand test events isolated from production. Missing for 10: evidence of event types beyond transaction statuses, documented production retry/delivery guarantees (sandbox test events get one attempt with no retries), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: You register a subscription — a callback URL, the transaction statuses you care about, and a signing secret — and Clara POSTs the event to your URL, signed with HMAC-SHA256.
Sandbox supports webhook subscriptions and on-demand events, isolated from production.
Sent on demand with `POST /api-test/v3/webhooks/events`; one attempt, no retries
